def summarise_memory({{history}}, {{llm_call}}, {{threshold}}=20):
    if len({{history}}) < {{threshold}}: return {{history}}
    old = {{history}}[:-5]
    recent = {{history}}[-5:]
    text = "\n".join(f"{m['role']}: {m['content']}" for m in old)
    summary = {{llm_call}}(f"Summarise the conversation in 200 words:\n{text}")
    return [{"role": "system", "content": f"Prior context: {summary}"}] + recent
summary_zh: 當對話超過門檻把舊訊息壓成 200 字摘要當 system 注入
